subject: AWS private offer: rev-share carveout + Net-60 billing — exec approval request
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS private offer: rev-share carveout + Net-60 billing — exec approval request

Team,

Quick summary from my call with Nimbus this morning — they want to go via an AWS Private Offer (account is already in their AWS Org). Key asks: 1) 25% list discount for first 12 months (annual commitment), 2) billing cadence Net-60 (finance requirement), and 3) they are requesting the marketplace rev-share carveout to route a 10% reseller override to their implementation partner (Partner: Ravel Systems).

What Deal Desk needs to confirm: can we accept Net-60 (with revenue deferral) and approve a one-time rev-share carveout that effectively leaves Redwood with 5% less marketplace take in year 1? The economics on the attached spreadsheet show acceptable unit economics at the proposed discount if we keep the marketing/marketplace fee at 22% instead of our standard 18% (net impact to Redwood ARR ~ -6% year 1).

Ask: Exec sign-off required for (A) exception to billing terms (Net-60) and (B) approval to commit to the marketplace carveout that routes a 10% partner override and increases overall marketplace fee to 22% for the first year only. If approved, we will: 1) request AWS to set the private offer with the adjusted rev-share, 2) include a one-time commission adjustment for the AE (10% uplift), and 3) proceed to DocuSign.

Attachments: Nimbus-PO-Draft.pdf, SOW-Nimbus-Redwood-2028.pdf, aws-private-offer-terms-annotated.docx

I recommend approval with a cap: carveout applies only to year 1; renewal reverts to standard terms.

Thanks,
Rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1-415-555-0198
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private offer: rev-share carveout + Net-60 billing — exec approval request

Rachel — thanks for the write-up, good context. A couple of quick notes from deal desk review:
- Net-60 is workable if Procurement signs a credit policy addendum and finance agrees to the deferral schedule (tracked in the HubSpot deal).
- The 10% reseller override is unusual but not impossible; AWS will require a justification business case.
- Pricing team flagged the AE commission uplift; we need manager/ops approval before we create the one-off comp plan.

I'm looping Marissa for manager sign-off and asking her to escalate to Vivek for exec approval on the marketplace carveout and billing exception.

Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Deal Desk Lead | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-23T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: AWS private offer: rev-share carveout + Net-60 billing — exec approval request

Vivek — forwarding Rachel's ask. TL;DR: Nimbus (mid-market retail chain) wants an AWS private offer with: 25% first-year discount, Net-60 billing, and a partner override that increases marketplace fee to ~22% in year 1. Finance model attached shows ~6% ARR hit year 1 but acceptable LTV over 3 years.

Recommend options for exec decision:
1) APPROVE: One-year rev-share carveout (22% marketplace fee) + Net-60 + 10% AE commission uplift. Renewal reverts to standard 18% marketplace fee and normal billing terms.
2) COUNTER: Approve Net-60 and discount but deny marketplace carveout; provide a $50k onboarding credit to partner instead.
3) DENY: Hold to standard marketplace rev-share and Net-30 terms.

We need a quick decision — customer expects terms in writing by Friday EOD (Nimbus PM flagged procurement timelines).

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-23T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private offer: rev-share carveout + Net-60 billing — exec approval request

Thanks for the concise options. I approve Option 1 with two controls:
1) Carveout applies only to year 1; renewal MUST revert to standard marketplace rev-share (document this in the private offer terms).
2) Finance to record deferred revenue schedule and legal to add a clawback for the AE commission uplift if customer fails to pay within 90 days.

Please proceed to get the revised private offer drafted with these guardrails. Notify me if AWS pushes back on the carveout or requires additional justification; I am comfortable making a final call with AWS channel lead on the call.

Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@NimbusRetail.com>
Cc: procure@NimbusRetail.com, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-24T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — next steps and draft terms

Alicia — great to speak earlier. Per our internal approvals, Redwood can proceed with the AWS Private Offer under these conditions:
- First-year discount: 25% off list (applies to committed usage only)
- Marketplace fee adjusted to 22% for year 1 to allow a 10% reseller override to Ravel Systems (partner)
- Billing: Net-60; finance will apply a deferred revenue schedule and a 90-day payment clause for commission clawback
- Renewal: terms revert to standard marketplace fee (18%) and Net-30 billing unless renegotiated at renewal

I've attached the draft private offer and SOW for your review (Nimbus-PO-Draft.pdf, SOW-Nimbus-Redwood-2028.pdf). If this matches your understanding, we'll request AWS to create the private offer and send you a DocuSign link for signature.

Next steps: please confirm acceptance of the above by EOD Friday so we can hit your procurement window.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
